properties.description: Topic that payment events are published to.

properties.description: Number of partitions for the payment events topic.

properties.description: Replication factor for the payment events topic.

properties.description: Topic that events go to when processing fails for good.

properties.name: payment.outbox.poll-interval
properties.description: How long the outbox relay waits between polls once it has caught up.

properties.name: payment.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum outbox events published per relay transaction.

properties.name: payment.outbox.send-timeout
properties.description: Upper bound on waiting for Kafka to acknowledge one outbox batch.

properties.name: payment.outbox.retention
properties.description: How long published outbox events are kept before cleanup deletes them.

properties.name: payment.outbox.cleanup-cron
properties.description: When the outbox cleanup job runs (Spring cron expression).

properties.description: Starts the payment processor Kafka consumer.

properties.description: First retry delay for transient processing failures.

properties.name: payment.processing.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Factor the retry delay grows by after each attempt.

properties.name: payment.processing.retry.max-interval
properties.description: Longest delay between retries.

properties.name: payment.processing.retry.max-retries
properties.description: Retries before an event is sent to the dead-letter topic.

properties.name: payment.processing.retry.circuit-open-interval
properties.description: Retry delay while the bank circuit breaker is open (retried without limit).
